description: Live price range (min, median, max USD per GPU-hour) and free GPU count for each GPU model rentable on Lium right now. Use for "what does an H100 cost" or comparing models; use search_gpus to pick a node to rent. Pass count for multi-GPU quotes: a 1-GPU price can come from a node with one free GPU.

count.description: GPUs needed on one node: prices only nodes that can rent that many

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, DE

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100, H200, B200, RTX 4090 (case and spacing ignored)

name: get_gpu_prices
title: Lium GPU prices
